method: Matched saved official games; escape threshold calculated from recorded dawn and last-action observations using frozen admission forecast; no new game, future shop or private opponent input. Economic exclusion is an observed policy threshold, not proof abandonment was optimal.

sequential_parity.method: Two independent namespaces, sequential complete observations; no interpreter transitions or new game. Source and official last-callable artifact loader receive identical observation copies. Recorded action is next replay step.

bootstrap.unit: seed, retaining both seats and both opponents
bootstrap.interpretation: Development screening after candidate exploration; not untouched validation or a corrected post-selection confidence guarantee.

reliability.note: The compact benchmark stores aggregated stderr counts only. No per-turn fallback attribution can be reconstructed from the replay alone.
